rawRetro.summary: 修复“设备售后服务与巡检协同系统”的 12 项验收缺陷。浏览器 QA 看到的应用几乎是空的：只有首页，没有业务页面、演示账号、业务资源、工作流、调度、通知、知识库或 AI 助手。根因不是单个 bug，而是上一轮实现只落了 10 个 server 端文件——没有 client 页面、没有路由注册、没有 workflow、没有 seed、没有 service 实现。本轮补齐了完整的五处落点（migration 表、server/routes 接口、client/pages 页面、client/routes.ts 路由、locales 文案），在本地 SQLite 上跑通全部业务链路：客户/设备/工单/巡检/知识文章/仪表盘、工单附件与内容路由鉴权、共享规则、外部事件幂等接入、API Key 最小权限、Scheduler 巡检计划与逾期提醒、AI 知识库设置页与 AI 员工“服务助手”。所有验收以真实 HTTP + 真实数据库为准，AI 问答/向量化因环境缺少 LLM 与向量库，按失败原因原样展示并记 blocked/not_run，未用固定答案冒充完成。

blockers.title: 应用整体为空——缺页面、路由、工作流、seed 与 service 实现
blockers.symptom: 浏览器 QA：仅首页可见，仪表盘/工单/设备/巡检/知识库/日程/通知/AI 助手均无入口或空白
blockers.rootCause: 上一轮只写了 server/service/* 的 10 个文件，未写 client 页面、未在 client/routes.ts 注册路由、未定义 workflow、未写 seed，也没有把 service 绑定到 provider/route
blockers.resolution: 补齐五处落点：migration 建表、server/routes + provider 暴露接口、client/pages 写页面、client/routes.ts 声明路由与导航、client/locales 补全中英文案；用 /tmp/run-all.sh 在全新 SQLite 上端到端验证
blockers.cost: 约 5 小时（含反复的 dev server 冷启动）

blockers.title: 组合权限动作被误判为拒绝（授权 403）
blockers.symptom: supervisor 调用 /service/* 组合接口返回 403，即使权限已被授予
blockers.rootCause: app-plugin-authorization 的 require() 只在 permit 时通过，而通过 composite 授权解析出的决策是 conditional，因此被当成拒绝；同时路由未先做 auth.required() 再挂 authz.middleware()
blockers.resolution: server/routes/service.ts 与 server/routes/files.ts 统一改为 auth.required() + authorization.middleware()，再用 authorize() 取决策并仅在 decision.effect === 'deny' 时拒绝；组合接口全部带显式 allRecords 数据范围并在 service 层做 JS 侧过滤

blockers.title: AI Knowledge Base 离线无法通过公开路径预置知识库
blockers.symptom: 按 Skill 文档的 manifest 路径（config.yml 中 ai.aiKnowledgeBase.manifests 的 init/append/recover）创建知识库会在进入创建前失败；直接写表会绕过插件归一化
blockers.rootCause: 插件不导出 KnowledgeBaseManager，只有 knowledgeBaseManifestServiceToken.apply()/state()，且 manifest 路径要求已启用的向量库与 LLM 服务；没有公开的 provisioning service，config.yml 又属受保护路径
blockers.resolution: 不后门写表。改为通过真实 HTTP（/api/ai/aiKnowledgeBase:create + :upload）由主管在 UI 内创建知识库并上传两份短 Markdown 手册；文档显示真实 indexStatus=ERROR 与 errorMessage='Vector database service-vectors not found'；检索/Q&A 记 blocked/not_run
blockers.cost: 约 1 小时（含确认没有公开 provisioning 入口）

blockers.title: 设备日期字段导致 PATCH 500
blockers.symptom: 编辑设备时把安装/保修/下次巡检日期提交为 YYYY-MM-DD，接口返回 500，RepositoryError: Invalid datetime value ... at most millisecond precision
blockers.rootCause: collection 字段是 datetime，而浏览器 date input 只给 date-only 字符串，未在服务边界归一化
blockers.resolution: 在 server/service/catalog-service.ts 增加 normalizeTemporal()，把 YYYY-MM-DD 锚定到 UTC 零点、其他值解析为 ISO，并同时用于 createDevice 与 updateDevice，使 toDateInput() 能往返

blockers.title: 巡检计划未生成“当天”任务，且逾期通知显示原始设备 id
blockers.symptom: 每日巡检计划生成的 plannedDate 取设备 nextInspectionAt，而非当天，导致“生成当天巡检任务”不成立、同设备同日去重失去意义；逾期通知标题显示“巡检已逾期：1”
blockers.rootCause: planDue 用 device.nextInspectionAt 的日期作为 plannedDate；通知直接用 deviceId 拼标题
blockers.resolution: planDue 改为 plannedDate = today（去重键 (deviceId, plannedDate)），并跳过 disabled 设备与已有未完成巡检的设备；通知构建 deviceId→deviceNo 映射、过滤 disabled 后显示设备编号

blockers.title: 聚焦测试在缺少 auth 插件时启动失败
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 组装最小 runtime（plugins 为空）时启动报 'Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered'
blockers.rootCause: ServiceModuleProvider.boot() 与 ticketFileGuard register() 无条件 resolve authorization/authentication token
blockers.resolution: 用 container.has(token) 守卫：业务层与文件守卫在 auth 插件缺席时保持不安装/不启动，但不阻断应用启动；真实运行时这两个插件始终存在，安全语义不变

improvements.title: 组合权限动作应使用 authorize() 而非 require()
improvements.detail: app-plugin-authorization 的 require() 仅在 permit 时通过，而 composite 授权解析出的决策是 conditional，会被 require() 判为拒绝并返回 403。授权文档只说明 require() 用于无条件能力，未强调组合能力必须用 authorize() 并只在 deny 时拒绝。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/core-api.md 的 require() 说明处补一句：数据库/组合能力用 authorize() 取完整决策，仅在 effect==='deny' 时拒绝

delivery.acceptanceRequirements:
每项只使用一组代表性正反场景，不展开全角色×全状态×全格式组合。浏览器 QA 验证页面行为；直接 API、并发/重复请求和服务端边界由实现阶段的针对性测试提供证据，不能用截图代替。

B01. 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

B02. 普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。

B03. 负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。

B04. 甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。

B05. 有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。

B06. 上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。

B07. 受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。

B08. 用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。

B09. 主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。

B10. 通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。

B11. 主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

B12. 助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。

实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。

retro.summary: 修复“设备售后服务与巡检协同系统”的 12 项验收缺陷。浏览器 QA 看到的应用几乎是空的：只有首页，没有业务页面、演示账号、业务资源、工作流、调度、通知、知识库或 AI 助手。根因不是单个 bug，而是上一轮实现只落了 10 个 server 端文件——没有 client 页面、没有路由注册、没有 workflow、没有 seed、没有 service 实现。本轮补齐了完整的五处落点（migration 表、server/routes 接口、client/pages 页面、client/routes.ts 路由、locales 文案），在本地 SQLite 上跑通全部业务链路：客户/设备/工单/巡检/知识文章/仪表盘、工单附件与内容路由鉴权、共享规则、外部事件幂等接入、API Key 最小权限、Scheduler 巡检计划与逾期提醒、AI 知识库设置页与 AI 员工“服务助手”。所有验收以真实 HTTP + 真实数据库为准，AI 问答/向量化因环境缺少 LLM 与向量库，按失败原因原样展示并记 blocked/not_run，未用固定答案冒充完成。

blockers.title: 应用整体为空——缺页面、路由、工作流、seed 与 service 实现
blockers.symptom: 浏览器 QA：仅首页可见，仪表盘/工单/设备/巡检/知识库/日程/通知/AI 助手均无入口或空白
blockers.rootCause: 上一轮只写了 server/service/* 的 10 个文件，未写 client 页面、未在 client/routes.ts 注册路由、未定义 workflow、未写 seed，也没有把 service 绑定到 provider/route
blockers.resolution: 补齐五处落点：migration 建表、server/routes + provider 暴露接口、client/pages 写页面、client/routes.ts 声明路由与导航、client/locales 补全中英文案；用 /tmp/run-all.sh 在全新 SQLite 上端到端验证
blockers.cost: 约 5 小时（含反复的 dev server 冷启动）

blockers.title: 组合权限动作被误判为拒绝（授权 403）
blockers.symptom: supervisor 调用 /service/* 组合接口返回 403，即使权限已被授予
blockers.rootCause: app-plugin-authorization 的 require() 只在 permit 时通过，而通过 composite 授权解析出的决策是 conditional，因此被当成拒绝；同时路由未先做 auth.required() 再挂 authz.middleware()
blockers.resolution: server/routes/service.ts 与 server/routes/files.ts 统一改为 auth.required() + authorization.middleware()，再用 authorize() 取决策并仅在 decision.effect === 'deny' 时拒绝；组合接口全部带显式 allRecords 数据范围并在 service 层做 JS 侧过滤

blockers.title: AI Knowledge Base 离线无法通过公开路径预置知识库
blockers.symptom: 按 Skill 文档的 manifest 路径（config.yml 中 ai.aiKnowledgeBase.manifests 的 init/append/recover）创建知识库会在进入创建前失败；直接写表会绕过插件归一化
blockers.rootCause: 插件不导出 KnowledgeBaseManager，只有 knowledgeBaseManifestServiceToken.apply()/state()，且 manifest 路径要求已启用的向量库与 LLM 服务；没有公开的 provisioning service，config.yml 又属受保护路径
blockers.resolution: 不后门写表。改为通过真实 HTTP（/api/ai/aiKnowledgeBase:create + :upload）由主管在 UI 内创建知识库并上传两份短 Markdown 手册；文档显示真实 indexStatus=ERROR 与 errorMessage='Vector database service-vectors not found'；检索/Q&A 记 blocked/not_run
blockers.cost: 约 1 小时（含确认没有公开 provisioning 入口）

blockers.title: 设备日期字段导致 PATCH 500
blockers.symptom: 编辑设备时把安装/保修/下次巡检日期提交为 YYYY-MM-DD，接口返回 500，RepositoryError: Invalid datetime value ... at most millisecond precision
blockers.rootCause: collection 字段是 datetime，而浏览器 date input 只给 date-only 字符串，未在服务边界归一化
blockers.resolution: 在 server/service/catalog-service.ts 增加 normalizeTemporal()，把 YYYY-MM-DD 锚定到 UTC 零点、其他值解析为 ISO，并同时用于 createDevice 与 updateDevice，使 toDateInput() 能往返

blockers.title: 巡检计划未生成“当天”任务，且逾期通知显示原始设备 id
blockers.symptom: 每日巡检计划生成的 plannedDate 取设备 nextInspectionAt，而非当天，导致“生成当天巡检任务”不成立、同设备同日去重失去意义；逾期通知标题显示“巡检已逾期：1”
blockers.rootCause: planDue 用 device.nextInspectionAt 的日期作为 plannedDate；通知直接用 deviceId 拼标题
blockers.resolution: planDue 改为 plannedDate = today（去重键 (deviceId, plannedDate)），并跳过 disabled 设备与已有未完成巡检的设备；通知构建 deviceId→deviceNo 映射、过滤 disabled 后显示设备编号

blockers.title: 聚焦测试在缺少 auth 插件时启动失败
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 组装最小 runtime（plugins 为空）时启动报 'Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered'
blockers.rootCause: ServiceModuleProvider.boot() 与 ticketFileGuard register() 无条件 resolve authorization/authentication token
blockers.resolution: 用 container.has(token) 守卫：业务层与文件守卫在 auth 插件缺席时保持不安装/不启动，但不阻断应用启动；真实运行时这两个插件始终存在，安全语义不变

improvements.title: AI Knowledge Base 的 HTTP 基路径与文档不符
improvements.detail: references/http-api.md 声明基路径为 /v2/api，但本应用中知识库动作实际挂在 /api/ai 下（/api/ai/aiKnowledgeBase:list 等），architecture.md 又同时提到 /api 与兼容 /v2/api。按 /v2/api 探测会 404，浪费排查时间。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base/references/http-api.md 增加“如何确定实际挂载路径”（如从路由清单或首次 404 响应核对），并统一 /api 与 /v2/api 的表述

improvements.title: 组合权限动作应使用 authorize() 而非 require()
improvements.detail: app-plugin-authorization 的 require() 仅在 permit 时通过，而 composite 授权解析出的决策是 conditional，会被 require() 判为拒绝并返回 403。授权文档只说明 require() 用于无条件能力，未强调组合能力必须用 authorize() 并只在 deny 时拒绝。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/core-api.md 的 require() 说明处补一句：数据库/组合能力用 authorize() 取完整决策，仅在 effect==='deny' 时拒绝

improvements.title: 文件插件字节路由默认不鉴权，需应用自行接管
improvements.detail: app-plugin-file 的字节访问路由（accessPath）按插件设计不做鉴权，应用必须为业务附件补上“按所属记录可见性”的守卫；Skill 未明确提示这一点，容易直接暴露附件。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md 增加“文件字节路由的鉴权归应用所有”的说明与最小示例

improvements.title: 离线环境无法预置 AI 知识库，应指导如何如实记 blocked
improvements.detail: Skill 描述了 manifest 与服务 API，但没有直说：缺少已启用的向量库与 LLM 时，任何公开路径都无法完成创建/索引；也没有给出“上传成功≠可用于问答，失败必须显示原因”的验证清单。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base/SKILL.md 增加一节“缺模型/向量库时的验收口径”：允许的降级范围、必须展示的真实状态字段（indexStatus/errorMessage），以及 blocked/not_run 的记录要求

improvements.title: NocoBase 3 Repository 无 destroy()，易与 NocoBase 2 混淆
improvements.detail: 本轮多次出现 destroy() 类型错误；NocoBase 3 的 Repository 只有 deleteOne()/deleteMany()。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-db/SKILL.md 的方法列表旁显式标注“无 destroy()，一律 deleteOne/deleteMany”，并说明从 NocoBase 2 迁移时的替换

modules.name: 授权与访问控制（Authorization）
modules.scope: @nocobase/authorization 决策内核与 @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 的 permission sets/数据库策略，及授权 Skill；覆盖岗位权限、记录级可见性与分享/保密例外。

requirements.need: 岗位（主管/工程师/观察员/集成用户）的能力与记录级可见性
requirements.responsibility: authorization 提供 grant/decision 与记录策略；app-plugin-authorization 提供 permission sets 与数据库策略
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 createAppAuthorization 注册 permission sets，业务端点用 authorize() 或条件策略，仅无条件能力用 require()
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/routes/service.ts 挂 auth.required()+authorization.middleware()，guard() 依 decision.effect==="deny" 拒绝

requirements.need: 临时分享与保密工单例外的表达
requirements.responsibility: authorization 的 composite/conditional 决策 + 分享/限制规则插件
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用既有分享/限制能力表达，不另建平行权限系统
requirements.actualUsage: 应用组合 authz-sharing-rules 与 authz-restriction-rules 并在业务端点消费 conditions

requirementFit.reason: 授权内核覆盖能力与记录级裁决，复合动作与条件策略的表达力满足岗位/分享场景；应用侧已正确消费。

usability.reason: authorize/can/require 语义清晰，但 require 对 composite 恒返回 conditional 的约束需要读文档才能避免误用。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 与 core-api 明确写出 require 拒绝 conditional、业务端点用 authorize，Agent 可据此避免自建平行权限。

design.reason: 决策模型分层清晰：资源类型注册、composite 组合、数据库策略与 snapshot 关注点分离。

reliability.reason: 未注册类型、缺 conditions 的 conditional 与 handler 失败一律 deny，失败路径明确。

modules.limitations: 未运行授权端到端场景；仅按源码/Skill 与应用挂载点核对。

modules.name: 数据建模、迁移与 Repository
modules.scope: @nocobase/db 的迁移、Repository 与 temporal 归一化，及 nocobase-db Skill；覆盖客户/设备/工单/附件等集合建模与读写。

requirements.need: 客户/设备/工单/附件等集合建模与可重复迁移
requirements.responsibility: defineMigration/defineSeed 提供自包含迁移与幂等 seed，Repository 提供类型化读写
requirements.recommendedUsage: 迁移自包含且合并后不可变，seed 用 upsert 保持幂等
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移 202610200001 自包含、无外键，符合约定

requirements.need: 时间字段的写入与类型保真
requirements.responsibility: Repository 对 temporal 字段做 V1 精度校验并公开归一化函数
requirements.recommendedUsage: 优先传入 Date/ISO 时间值，必要时用公开的 normalizeTemporalValue
requirements.actualUsage: 应用自写 normalizeTemporal 把日期输入转为时间戳后再写入

requirementFit.reason: 迁移/Repository/temporal 能力覆盖建模与读写需求，应用集合数量与关系可由公开 API 表达。

usability.reason: Repository 边界（空 scope、嵌套写、writePolicy 默认）需要读 Skill 才不易踩坑；date-only 输入不给出引导性提示。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 详列方法边界与迁移约定，帮助 Agent 避坑；temporal 输入格式说明仍偏少。

design.reason: Repository 以 policy 组合读写范围，temporal 归一化独立成模块并公开导出。

reliability.reason: 非法时间值、空 scope、越界关系写入均以显式错误拒绝。

modules.limitations: 未执行迁移与读写；未验证 SQLite 下时间字段行为的运行时表现。

modules.name: Workflow 工单受理
modules.scope: @nocobase/app-plugin-workflow 的源码管理 Workflow（defineWorkflow/指令/执行服务）与 Workflow Skill；覆盖受理分支、执行记录与重复受理幂等。

requirements.need: 受理工单的分支工作流、执行记录与失败可查
requirements.responsibility: Workflow 提供持久执行状态、条件分支与 run 节点调用应用服务
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 Workflow DSL 表达阶段/分支，业务原子操作留在 typed code 供 run 节点调用
requirements.actualUsage: 应用定义 ticket-acceptance workflow，用 ConditionInstruction 分支产出受理说明

requirements.responsibility: WorkflowService 以 eventKey 去重并复用既有 run

reliability.reason: 禁用/未找到返回 skipped，非法输入显式报错，eventKey 重复返回既有 run。

modules.limitations: 未实际触发 workflow；失败恢复与重试路径未做运行时验证。

modules.name: 计划任务（Scheduler）

requirements.responsibility: Scheduler 提供 cron 定义、target 注册与 occurrence 执行记录

Skill 明确：require 需无条件 permit 且拒绝 conditional，业务端点用 authorize 并消费 conditions.database。
evidence.excerpt:
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the Repository route definition and bind each method to its composite action with `authz.database.authorizeRepository`. Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions need custom handlers. `authz.database.policyFor` folds collection grants; without its third argument it does not respect a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.

evidence.observation: core-api 表逐条写明 authorize/can/require/snapshot 语义，并说明未知类型与无条件 conditional 一律拒绝。
evidence.excerpt:
| `AuthorizationContext` member              | Result and use                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `authorize({ resource, action, params? })` | The full decision: `permit`, `deny`, or `conditional` with `conditions`, and `reasons`                                                                                          |
| `can(request)`                             | `true` only for `permit`; a business check reports feature availability, not record access                                                                                      |
| `require(request)`                         | Throws `AuthorizationDeniedError`, which answers `403 { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message }` without an `onError`, unless the decision is `permit`; use for unconditional capabilities |
| `snapshot()`                               | `{ unrestricted, permissions }` for the client; not an executable data policy                                                                                                   |

Create one context per request and reuse it within that request only, never across identities. Its grant and rule reads are shared by the underlying checks of a business action. Execute a conditional decision only through the adapter that understands its conditions. Unknown types, unregistered catalog items or actions, conditional decisions without conditions and handler failures deny.

evidence.excerpt:
The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.

# Choose the Task Path

- Before designing a new business feature, creating a workflow, or moving existing behavior into Workflow, read [Workflow Architecture Decisions](references/workflow-concepts.md) and decide whether the behavior belongs in Workflow, ordinary typed code, or a combination of both. - For creating, editing, reviewing, or validating a workflow package, read the relevant sections of [DSL Authoring](references/dsl-authoring.md). Read the complete example only when authoring a package or when several DSL contracts interact.
- For extending node types, read [Custom Instructions](references/custom-instructions.md) for the decision criteria, public API, complete application example, async Provider registration, and shared checker/build contracts.
- For business invocation, enablement, administrator parameters, or an authorized manual run, read [Invocation and Service API](references/invocation-and-service-api.md).
- For inspecting definitions or diagnosing a run, read [Execution Diagnostics](references/execution-diagnostics.md).

Use only the path relevant to the request. Ask a question only when the target, input, business behavior, or side-effect impact cannot be determined safely from the request and available source or runtime evidence.

The workflow plugin itself currently exports `ConditionInstruction`, `RunInstruction`, and `TerminateInstruction`.

## Decide Whether to Use Scheduler

The primary reason to define tasks through Scheduler is **UI observability for business administrators**. Developers define schedules and execution logic in code. Business administrators use the application's task list and detail pages to view schedules, track individual executions, and enable or disable tasks when authorized.

Tasks that do not need to be viewed and tracked through the UI must not be managed by the Scheduler plugin. Use the application's Queue or existing background scheduling mechanism for those tasks. For administrator-visible tasks, deliver Client registration, access permissions, meaningful task names, and accurate final execution status together; successful server-side dispatch alone is incomplete.

## Then Choose the Execution Model

After deciding to use Scheduler, choose according to business complexity:

| Scenario                                                                                  | Choice          | Implementation boundary                                                                                    |

| Periodic cleanup, cache refresh, a single report, or one business Service call            | Own target type | Short operations may complete directly; dispatch lengthy, batch, or retryable work to a business Queue Job |

This page is the application side: where the directories live, how `pnpm nocobase db apply` runs them, how additional connections configure their tasks, and what to do about checksum drift and compiled manifests.

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. ## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

## Multiple connections

Use `database/<connectionName>/migrations` and `database/<connectionName>/seeds`. Each name must match a configured connection and contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Directories do not register connections. A connection without application-owned database source needs no empty directory.

The default connection runs migrations and seeds automatically unless disabled; other connections default to `autoRun: false`. Startup runs the default connection first, then other names in stable ascending order, migrations before seeds within each connection. A failure stops startup; completed database changes remain committed. No cross-connection transaction or rollback is provided.

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply --connection analytics
pnpm nocobase db apply --all --json
```

An entry carries `connection`, `kind` (`migrations` or `seeds`) and its own `status`, plus `batch` (migrations only), `executed` and `skipped` once the task has run. A run with nothing pending answers `status: "success-noop"`, and so does an application with no database configured, with `result.state: "not-configured"`. It removes the managed schema objects — which clears migration and seed history along with every row in a managed table — then reruns all currently visible migrations and seeds from empty. It never calls migration `down()`. In an interactive terminal it asks for confirmation. CI and non-interactive terminals require `--force`, so use `pnpm nocobase db reset --force` only when the target is intentionally disposable. It is rejected for an explicitly selected external connection; `--all` processes managed connections and reports external connections as skipped. It is limited to connections with a registered driver reset capability.

`pnpm nocobase db rollback` runs `down()` for every migration in the latest batch, newest first, and deletes its history records. The batch is the unit the history records, so a batch that mixed application and plugin migrations rolls back as one: the confirmation lists every migration and the package it belongs to before anything runs.
